title: Finite-energy hard celestial current algebra from the Banerjee--Mandal--Sahoo dipole Ward identity in QED
summary: We use the Banerjee--Mandal--Sahoo dipole-current Ward identity for the one-loop logarithmic soft-photon theorem as input and determine its finite-energy action on Mellin-difference hard currents. The commutator with such hard currents has a scheme-independent hard-hard residue that survives every one-particle redefinition. With the meromorphic continuation stated explicitly below, a two-particle Plancherel transform identifies this residue with an analytic two-particle primary module, and the coefficient map is a hard-current one-cocycle.
